但是这种操控对普通人来说，伤害极大，轻者可以造成失忆，重者可以让人脑死亡而变成植物人。所以，雷战要在贝拉被伤害之前，问出所有的东西来。

“八嘎！”战士只来得及骂一声，便直接翻身避开了这道攻击，随后，方才看向天空，此刻，林帆正带着一脸戏谑的表情看向自己。

佣兵们的身体一与这些黑烟接触，便像是被火烫了一般，大声尖叫起来。

将再缘闻言，脸色顿时一惊，一个修仙家族居然有几名高阶修士，而且这还单单只是一个宗派，要是别的宗派呢？将再缘一时间被震惊到了。

“灵魂玉很稀少”我本想把我裤兜上的那一块玉给茅一刀看看，可又听见很稀少这三个字，顿时打消的念头，虽然茅一刀有了一块了，可万一他贪心一起，把我这里颗玉给收了，那就亏大发了。

为了不让残片落入魔王的手中，他们只能离开了自己的国家，去了一个遥远而又神秘的地域，继续的保护残片。

捂着鼻子，我手中紧握着麻绳的圈。王喜似乎知道我要做什么，双脚使劲的蹦弹，比起刚才还有有力几倍，一时间又把几个村民给甩飞了出去。

迟疑中的我对着巨大的黑色眼球说出一句话，一句改变自己命运以至于改变整个神魔游戏命运的话。

不过内修的基本功修炼出来的功力很原始，能与任何功法融会贯通，因此将再缘才会想着一直修炼基本功来增强功力。

林飞有点惊喜，想不到，作为主人，可以吸收炼化奴隶的神识力。

However, this kind of manipulation is extremely harmful to ordinary people. In mild cases, it can cause amnesia, and in severe cases, it can cause brain death and turn a person into a vegetative state.Therefore, Lei Zhan wanted to ask everything before Bella was hurt.

"Baga!" The warrior only had time to curse before he turned over to avoid the attack. Then he looked at the sky. At this moment, Lin Fan was looking at him with a joking expression on his face.

As soon as the mercenaries' bodies came into contact with the black smoke, they screamed loudly as if they were burned by fire.

When Jiang Zaoyuan heard this, his face was suddenly shocked. There were actually several high-level monks in a cultivating family, and this was just a sect. What if it was another sect?Jiang Zaoyuan was shocked for a moment.

"Soul jade is very rare." I originally wanted to show the jade in my trouser pocket to Mao Yidao, but when I heard the word "rare", I immediately gave up the idea. Although Mao Yidao had one, if he was greedy and took away the jade from me, he would be in big trouble.

In order to prevent the fragments from falling into the hands of the devil, they had no choice but to leave their country and go to a remote and mysterious area to continue to protect the fragments.

Covering my nose, I held the loop of hemp rope tightly in my hand.Wang Xi seemed to know what I was going to do. He bounced hard with his feet, which was several times more powerful than before. He threw several villagers away in an instant.

While hesitating, I said a word into the huge black eyeballs, a word that would change my own destiny and the fate of the entire game between gods and demons.

However, the skills gained from the basic skills of internal cultivation are very primitive and can be integrated with any other skills. Therefore, I will continue to practice the basic skills to enhance my skills.

Lin Fei was a little surprised. He didn't expect that as a master, he could absorb the consciousness of the refined slave.
